reviewContinuity.scope: Restricted recheck of the reproduced production worker-packaging regression, the one-line packaging fix and regressions caused by that fix. No new whole-milestone hunt.

evidenceInspected: Retained AGENTS.md, REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md, reviewer persona and prior rounds. Rechecked startup status, current D3 plan and Technical Decisions startup contract. Node v24.21.0; D3 IN_PROGRESS and D3-PHONE-UPDATE NEEDS_SETUP. ci:status could not fetch the committed result.

Read .evidence/D3/ci-startup-update-failure.json and continuation-handoff.json. Full CI 38696008092 failed the built WebKit update journey before the main browser suite. The a4ff839 failure and interrupted obsolete local recorder remain recorded; neither is a full PASS.

Read the immutable-comparison evidence for diagnostic 38697149790: a4ff839 failed while 33ac7c9 passed under the same diagnostic. Read the actual registration-observe capture from run 38697800765: registration false/undefined, broker received with zero prior entries, registration reevaluated with one broker, then factory saw zero brokers. The page displayed ARCHIVIO NON DISPONIBILE. This supports the recorded packaging diagnosis.

Compared the exact committed source range. Its sole application/build-source change removes worker: { format: "es" } from vite.config.ts. Application source, tests, SDK versions, lockfile, browser projects, CI workflow and verification scripts are unchanged. No idempotent-registration workaround or diagnostic logging was adopted.

Read installed Vite configuration code confirming the stock worker format is IIFE. The production bundling change removes worker code splitting; it does not change the Worker constructor, worker selection, database naming, compiled-module cache, engine instance lifetime, persistent VFS or write guards.

Independently parsed both final generated worker files with TypeScript. Each is a single IIFE containing IDBBatchAtomicVFS and has zero static imports and zero dynamic imports. Therefore neither worker can import its own entry through a split VFS chunk. The dedicated bundle has exactly one assignment to the private worker state; the stock bundle has none. Neither contains the diagnostic log markers.

Inspected dist/sw.js: both final worker filenames are precached. Other main-app chunks remain separate; their presence is not worker code splitting. Generated-worker hashes and sizes are recorded in artifactInspection.

Directly read OS-temp cvc-d3-inline-worker-ci.log, SHA256 a83b44943770d057cb9ae46a4d59e94ff0d05eb907535066611576bf20f7f229. Diagnostic run 38698033211/e12be3a builds 0.3.0 and 0.3.1, obtains service-worker control, offers the update in 0.19 seconds on Chromium and 0.33 seconds on WebKit, reloads into the new version and reports that typed notes survived. The original registration and update assertions remain in use; diagnostic observation code remains an evidence qualification.
